authored: G2940 GROUND-VEHICLE: NOT MEASURED. Written from the brief (wheelbase 3.01 m, track 1.41 m, wheel radius 0.35 m, ~1 850 kg) in tools/car_prep.py's schema, the frame's origin put between the axles on the ground; the body box, the lamps and the steering wheel are placeholders of a full-size regular-cab pickup. A run of tools/car_prep.py on the asset (ASSETS-OCT G2908) overwrites this file with the measured sheet - src/vehicle/vehicle.js reads only the schema's fields, so it drops in.

estimates.note: ESTIMATES, not measured: a 1989 full-size regular-cab pickup (curb ~1 800-1 950 kg, ~56 % front); the CG height and the inertia of a uniform box of the body's size; the driver's eye 0.50 m behind and 0.33 m above the steering wheel's centre. Tune in play.
